Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-access-layer
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate which Device Function or software layer(s) will be using all Control Numbers within this Control.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-access-mode
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the Access Mode that all Control Numbers within this Control will use.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-deferrable
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate whether the Control Numbers within this Control are deferrable or non-deferrable. Values: False (Default): All Control Numbers within this Control are non-deferrable. True (nonzero): All Control Numbers within this Control are deferrable.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-interrupt-position
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate this Control's position in the SDCA interrupt registers.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-cn-list
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate which Control Numbers this Control implements. Values: Bit 0 maps to Control Number 0, bit 18 maps to Control Number 18, etc. A value of 0b1 in a bit indicates that the Control Number is supported; 0b0 means the Control Number is not supported.

Package.Name: Sdca_ControlCN
Package.Description: This Property shall indicate the DC value of one Control Number for this Control.

Package.Name: Sdca_ControlCN
Package.Description: This Property shall indicate the system-preferred default value for one Control Number for this Control. This default value is not applicable to Controls whose Access Mode is DC or RO.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-dc-value
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the DC value of this Control. If the Control has more than one Control Number (i.e., if Property mipi-sdca-control-cn-list exists), then this value is applied to all Control Numbers.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-default-value
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the system-preferred default value for this Control. If the Control has more than one Control Number (i.e., if Property mipi-sdca-control-cn-list exists), then this value is applied to all Control Numbers. This default value is not applicable to Controls whose Access Mode is DC or RO.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-fixed-value
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the single, fixed value to which software is permitted to set this Control. This fixed value is not applicable to Controls whose Access Mode is DC or RO. This value informs the Host that it shall not write any other value to this Control. If the Control has more than one Control Number (i.e., if Property mipi-sdca-control-cn-list exists), then this value is applied to all Control Numbers. If any Property mipi-sdca-control-cn--fixed-value exists for this Control, then this Property shall not be present.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-cn-n-fixed-value
Property.Description: This Property shall indicate the single, fixed value to which software is permitted to set one Control Number for this Control. This fixed value is not applicable to Controls whose Access Mode is DC or RO. This value informs the Host that it shall not write any other value to this Control. If Property mipi-sdca-control-fixed-value exists for this Control, then this Property shall not be present. If any Property mipi-sdca-control-cn-n-fixed-value exists for this Control, then one such Property shall be present for every value that appears in Property mipi-sdca-control-cn-list for this Control. For each such Property, the value of n in the Property String shall match the corresponding value in Property mipi-sdca-control-cn-list.

BufferProperty.Description: This Buffer Property shall contain the name of an object that indicates the value range for this Control.

This Buffer Property shall contain the name of an object that indicates the value range of one Control Number for this Control. This Property shall use the same encoding as Property mipi-sdca-control-range for this Control.
